{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Environment

|descr= Changes the wind strength smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means there will be an immediate change.

|s1= time [[setWindStr]] value

|p1= time: [[Number]]

|p2= value: [[Number]] - new value in range 0..1

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>60 setWindStr 0.8; // set the wind strength to 0.8 gradually over the next 60 seconds</sqf>

|seealso= [[setWind]] [[setWindForce]]
}}

{{Note
|user= Sa-Matra
|timestamp= 20220801093946
|text= This weird command affects `setFog` by limiting maximum number of fogValue you can have. If you do <sqf inline>0 setWindStr 1</sqf>, setting any fog with time > 0 will reduce the fog to 0 over provided time. Setting fog instantly with time = 0 will set the desired value properly though. The formula is: max fogValue = 1 - windStr
}}
